summary: Risk-off conditions dominate markets today, with Bitcoin falling below $60,000 and broad weakness across crypto, equities, and commodities. The only constructive view found is Michaël van de Poppe’s expectation of an eventual bounce and his stated accumulation of Bitcoin below $58,000, but near-term volatility and downside risk remain elevated.[1][4][5][6]
